page.overview:
Who is Dariax Zaveon?

Dariax Zaveon is a dwarven sorcerer and member of the Crown Keepers. He is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dariax is a young mountain dwarf with wild, floppy, reddish-auburn hair and a chinstrap beard. He wears a vest over a chain shirt, and has a compass rose chained on his light chain necklace.

After touching the thorny circlet and failing his wisdom saving throw, Dariax's eyes turned inky black. They were restored to their normal "dreamy" brown color by Shaun Gilmore a few days later. for the original color.}}

Dariax is easygoing, reacting cheerfully to being pranked by his friends. However, he becomes intense when he realises he’s being lied to, as he has had bad experiences with people who lie a lot. He is impulsive and prone to throwing himself unthinkingly into dangerous situations.
